season.evidence: No stored season; web (climber trip reports, Mountaineers) shows north couloir/face climbs in early June and a mid-July north face ascent.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 12 Jul 2026; the report says the line was the north face (a diagonal gully) and it summits within 3 m of our summit, but the track is a camp-based loop from the Overcoat Lake basin, not a trailhead round trip or one-way from a trailhead, so no assignment.
20 May 2023 ski trip, also a multi-peak Overcoat zone link-up (Finger of Fate).

facts.text: In mid-July the north face went via a diagonal gully reached after crossing the glacier moat; one long pitch to the ridge with a single piece of protection on a 70 m rope, then an exposed scramble move to the summit.
In mid-July the descent was a class 4 downclimb to a rappel anchor about 50 ft above the gully, then crossing snow at the gully bottom while roped.
Route-finding on the upper mountain is hard even in clear weather; avoid it in cloud (July).

season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep with late July-August classic; logged Snow Finger (Jul), NE Gulley (Jul); web: Mountaineers offered it Aug 24-25, 2024, though snow-finger reports exist from early June.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 20 May 2023, a ski trip on the NE gully and a multi-peak zone link-up, so no East Face assignment.
Described by the party as a north face line from a basin camp.

notes: Dingford Creek trailhead pin is consistent with the 2023 track start (39 m), but that track is rejected. Peakbagger's summit agrees with ours to ~25 m. No ascent is logged under the name East Face.
